title: Woodland Scene 8 — Homes and Hiding Places
purpose: Animal homes, shelter, and choosing the right place for each animal.

sentenceModels: The rabbit is next to the burrow.
The fox is by the den.
The owl is on the branch.
The hedgehog is in the leaves.
The squirrel is on the stump.

adultSupport.focus: Talk about where animals might rest, hide or live.
starterPrompts: Which animal is by the den?
Which animal is on the stump?
expansionPrompts: Which place looks best for the rabbit?
Which animal might hide in the hollow log?
Can you match each animal to a place?

visualAudit: One squirrel on a stump holding an acorn.
One rabbit next to a burrow at the centre-right.
One fox beside a hollow log den on the right.
One owl on a branch above and one hedgehog in a pile of leaves on the left foreground.
